description: Ponctualité des relations IC - Stiptheid van IC-relatie - Monthly punctuality of IC relations is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Infrabel. Monthly punctuality of IC relations upon arrival at their destination or - for the trains travelling through Brussel's North-South junction, upon arrival at the first station of the junction on their path. A train is considered punctual if it arrives at the station with less than 6 minutes delay. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in CSV. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are MMTIS. The portal shows 2024-12-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
